## ETL

```{r ETL}
rm(list = ls())
library(eurostat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

#read the data and wide it
df <- get_eurostat("ext_ser_bec01", keepFlags = FALSE, time_format = "date")
df_wide <- df %>%
  mutate(year = format(TIME_PERIOD, "%Y")) %>% 
  select(-TIME_PERIOD) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = values
  )


# Countries' MAP
country_map <- c(
  'AT' = 'Austria',
  'BE' = 'Belgium',
  'BG' = 'Bulgaria',
  'CH' = 'Switzerland',
  'CY' = 'Cyprus',
  'CZ' = 'Czech Republic',
  'DE' = 'Germany',
  'DK' = 'Denmark',
  'EE' = 'Estonia',
  'EL' = 'Greece',
  'ES' = 'Spain',
  'FI' = 'Finland',
  'FR' = 'France',
  'HR' = 'Croatia',
  'HU' = 'Hungary',
  'IE' = 'Ireland',
  'IS' = 'Iceland',
  'IT' = 'Italy',
  'LT' = 'Lithuania',
  'LU' = 'Luxembourg',
  'LV' = 'Latvia',
  'MT' = 'Malta',
  'NL' = 'Netherlands',
  'NO' = 'Norway',
  'PL' = 'Poland',
  'PT' = 'Portugal',
  'RO' = 'Romania',
  'SE' = 'Sweden',
  'SI' = 'Slovenia',
  'SK' = 'Slovakia',
  'UK' = 'United Kingdom'
)

# Sectors' Map
mapping_en <- c(
  "BEC_SERV" = "Services",
  "BEC_SERV_IC" = "Services intermediate",
  "BEC_SERV_FC" = "Services final",
  "BEC121" = "Agriculture intermediate",
  "BEC123" = "Agriculture final",
  "BEC221" = "Mining & energy intermediate",
  "BEC223" = "Mining & energy final",
  "BEC321" = "Construction intermediate",
  "BEC323" = "Construction final",
  "BEC421" = "Textile & footwear intermediate",
  "BEC521" = "Transport & logistics intermediate",
  "BEC523" = "Transport & logistics final",
  "BEC621" = "ICT & financial services intermediate",
  "BEC623" = "ICT & financial services final",
  "BEC721" = "Health, education & culture intermediate",
  "BEC723" = "Health, education & culture final",
  "BEC821" = "Public administration intermediate"
)

# Partners' Map
mapping_partner <- c(
  "EXT_EU27_2020" = "UE2020",
  "WRL_REST" = "Rest_of_the_World"
)

#mapping the values
df_wide$geo <- recode(df_wide$geo, !!!country_map)
df_wide$bec_r5 <- recode(df_wide$bec_r5, !!!mapping_en)
df_wide$partner <- recode(df_wide$partner, !!!mapping_partner)


df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  select(-unit, -freq) %>%
  rename(
    State = geo, 
    Sector = bec_r5
  )

#View(df_wide)

# Format number
format_number <- function(x) {
  format(x, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
}

# General sectors mapping
map_sectors <- function(sector) {
  case_when(
    grepl("Agriculture", sector) ~ "Agriculture",
    grepl("Mining & energy", sector) ~ "Mining & Energy",
    grepl("Construction", sector) ~ "Construction",
    grepl("Textile & footwear", sector) ~ "Textile & Footwear",
    grepl("Transport & logistics", sector) ~ "Transport & Logistics",
    grepl("ICT & financial", sector) ~ "ICT & Financial Services",
    grepl("Health, education & culture", sector) ~ "Health, Education & Culture",
    grepl("Public administration", sector) ~ "Public Administration",
    grepl("Services", sector) ~ "Services",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

summary(df_wide)

```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# EXPLORATORY DATA ANALYSIS - INTERNATIONAL TRADE DATASET
# ============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

print("=== EXPLORATORY DATA ANALYSIS ===")
print("")

# ============================================================================
# 1. BASIC DATASET STRUCTURE
# ============================================================================
print("1. DATASET STRUCTURE")
print("-------------------")
print(paste("Dimensions:", nrow(df_wide), "rows x", ncol(df_wide), "columns"))
print(paste("Columns:", paste(colnames(df_wide), collapse=", ")))
print("")

print("Data types:")
print(sapply(df_wide, class))
print("")

print("First few rows:")
print(head(df_wide, 3))
print("")

# ============================================================================
# 2. MISSING VALUES ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
print("2. MISSING VALUES")
print("------------------")
missing_summary <- data.frame(
  Column = colnames(df_wide),
  Missing_Count = colSums(is.na(df_wide)),
  Missing_Percentage = round(colSums(is.na(df_wide)) / nrow(df_wide) * 100, 2)
)
print(missing_summary[missing_summary$Missing_Count > 0, ])
print("")

# ============================================================================
# 3. CATEGORICAL VARIABLES ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
print("3. CATEGORICAL VARIABLES")
print("-------------------------")

if("Sector" %in% colnames(df_wide)) {
  print(paste("Sectors (unique count):", length(unique(df_wide$Sector))))
  sector_counts <- table(df_wide$Sector)
  print("Top 5 sectors by frequency:")
  print(head(sort(sector_counts, decreasing = TRUE), 5))
}

if("partner" %in% colnames(df_wide)) {
  print("Partners:")
  print(table(df_wide$partner))
}

if("stk_flow" %in% colnames(df_wide)) {
  print("Trade Flow Types:")
  print(table(df_wide$stk_flow))
}

if("State" %in% colnames(df_wide)) {
  print(paste("States/Countries (unique count):", length(unique(df_wide$State))))
  print(paste("Sample countries:", paste(head(unique(df_wide$State), 10), collapse=", ")))
}
print("")

# ============================================================================
# 4. TEMPORAL ANALYSIS (assuming year columns exist)
# ============================================================================
print("4. TEMPORAL COVERAGE")
print("---------------------")

# Identify year columns
year_cols <- grep("^[0-9]{4}$", colnames(df_wide), value = TRUE)
if(length(year_cols) > 0) {
  print(paste("Year range:", min(year_cols), "-", max(year_cols)))
  print(paste("Number of years:", length(year_cols)))
  print("")
  
  # Calculate total trade per year
  yearly_totals <- sapply(year_cols, function(year) {
    sum(as.numeric(df_wide[[year]]), na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  
  print("Total trade volume by year:")
  yearly_df_wide <- data.frame(
    Year = year_cols,
    Total_Volume = yearly_totals,
    Formatted = format(yearly_totals, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
  )
  print(yearly_df_wide[, c("Year", "Formatted")])
  
  print(paste("Growth from first to last year:", 
      round((yearly_totals[length(yearly_totals)] / yearly_totals[1] - 1) * 100, 1), "%"))
}
print("")

# ============================================================================
# 5. TRADE VALUES ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
print("5. TRADE VALUES STATISTICS")
print("---------------------------")

if(length(year_cols) > 0) {
  # Get all numeric trade values
  all_values <- unlist(df_wide[, year_cols])
  all_values <- as.numeric(all_values[!is.na(all_values)])
  all_values <- all_values[all_values > 0]  # Remove zeros
  
  print("Overall Statistics (across all years):")
  print(paste("  Minimum:", format(min(all_values), big.mark = ","), "EUR"))
  print(paste("  Maximum:", format(max(all_values), big.mark = ","), "EUR"))
  print(paste("  Mean:", format(mean(all_values), big.mark = ","), "EUR"))
  print(paste("  Median:", format(median(all_values), big.mark = ","), "EUR"))
  print(paste("  Std Dev:", format(sd(all_values), big.mark = ","), "EUR"))
  
  print("Percentiles:")
  percentiles <- quantile(all_values, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99))
  for(i in 1:length(percentiles)) {
    print(paste("  ", names(percentiles)[i], ": ", 
        format(percentiles[i], big.mark = ","), " EUR", sep = ""))
  }
}
print("")

# ============================================================================
# 6. EXPORT vs IMPORT ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
print("6. EXPORT vs IMPORT COMPARISON")
print("-------------------------------")

if("stk_flow" %in% colnames(df_wide) && length(year_cols) > 0) {
  exp_data <- df_wide %>% filter(stk_flow == "EXP")
  imp_data <- df_wide %>% filter(stk_flow == "IMP")
  
  total_exp <- sum(as.numeric(unlist(exp_data[, year_cols])), na.rm = TRUE)
  total_imp <- sum(as.numeric(unlist(imp_data[, year_cols])), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  print(paste("Total Exports:", format(total_exp, big.mark = ","), "EUR"))
  print(paste("Total Imports:", format(total_imp, big.mark = ","), "EUR"))
  print(paste("Trade Balance:", format(total_exp - total_imp, big.mark = ","), "EUR"))
  print(paste("Export/Import Ratio:", round(total_exp / total_imp, 3)))
}
print("")

# ============================================================================
# 7. PARTNER ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
print("7. TRADE BY PARTNER")
print("--------------------")

if("partner" %in% colnames(df_wide) && length(year_cols) > 0) {
  partner_totals <- df_wide %>%
    group_by(partner) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_Trade = sum(across(all_of(year_cols), ~sum(as.numeric(.), na.rm = TRUE))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Total_Trade))
  
  partner_totals$Formatted <- format(partner_totals$Total_Trade, big.mark = ",")
  
  print("Trade volume by partner:")
  print(partner_totals[, c("partner", "Formatted")])
  
  print("Partner share:")
  partner_totals$Share <- round(partner_totals$Total_Trade / sum(partner_totals$Total_Trade) * 100, 1)
  print(partner_totals[, c("partner", "Share")])
}
print("")

# ============================================================================
# 8. TOP COUNTRIES ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
print("8. TOP TRADING COUNTRIES")
print("-------------------------")

if("State" %in% colnames(df_wide) && length(year_cols) > 0) {
  country_totals <- df_wide %>%
    group_by(State) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_Trade = sum(across(all_of(year_cols), ~sum(as.numeric(.), na.rm = TRUE))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Total_Trade)) %>%
    head(10)
  
  country_totals$Formatted <- format(country_totals$Total_Trade, big.mark = ",")
  
  print("Top 10 countries by total trade volume:")
  print(country_totals[, c("State", "Formatted")])
}
print("")

# ============================================================================
# 9. SECTOR ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
print("9. TOP SECTORS")
print("---------------")

if("Sector" %in% colnames(df_wide) && length(year_cols) > 0) {
  sector_totals <- df_wide %>%
    group_by(Sector) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_Trade = sum(across(all_of(year_cols), ~sum(as.numeric(.), na.rm = TRUE))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Total_Trade)) %>%
    head(10)
  
  sector_totals$Formatted <- format(sector_totals$Total_Trade, big.mark = ",")
  
  print("Top 10 sectors by total trade volume:")
  print(sector_totals[, c("Sector", "Formatted")])
}
print("")

# ============================================================================
# 10. OUTLIER DETECTION
# ============================================================================
print("10. OUTLIER DETECTION")
print("----------------------")

if(length(year_cols) > 0 && exists("all_values")) {
  # Using IQR method
  Q1 <- quantile(all_values, 0.25)
  Q3 <- quantile(all_values, 0.75)
  IQR_val <- Q3 - Q1
  
  lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_val
  upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_val
  
  outliers <- all_values[all_values > upper_bound]
  
  print("IQR Method:")
  print(paste("  Lower bound:", format(lower_bound, big.mark = ","), "EUR"))
  print(paste("  Upper bound:", format(upper_bound, big.mark = ","), "EUR"))
  print(paste("  Number of outliers (high values):", length(outliers)))
  print(paste("  Percentage of outliers:", round(length(outliers) / length(all_values) * 100, 2), "%"))
  
  if(length(outliers) > 0) {
    print("  Top 5 outlier values:")
    top_outliers <- head(sort(outliers, decreasing = TRUE), 5)
    for(i in 1:length(top_outliers)) {
      print(paste("    ", i, ": ", format(top_outliers[i], big.mark = ","), " EUR", sep = ""))
    }
  }
}
print("")

# ============================================================================
# 11. VOLATILITY/STABILITY ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
print("11. TRADE VOLATILITY")
print("---------------------")

if("State" %in% colnames(df_wide) && length(year_cols) > 0) {
  # Calculate coefficient of variation for each country
  country_cv <- df_wide %>%
    group_by(State) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_Trade = mean(across(all_of(year_cols), ~sum(as.numeric(.), na.rm = TRUE))),
      SD_Trade = sd(across(all_of(year_cols), ~sum(as.numeric(.), na.rm = TRUE))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(CV = SD_Trade / Mean_Trade) %>%
    filter(!is.na(CV) & !is.infinite(CV)) %>%
    arrange(desc(CV))
  
  print("Most volatile countries (highest coefficient of variation):")
  print(head(country_cv[, c("State", "CV")], 5))
  
  print("Most stable countries (lowest coefficient of variation):")
  print(tail(country_cv[, c("State", "CV")], 5))
}
print("")

print("=== END OF EXPLORATORY DATA ANALYSIS ===")
```

# Analysis

```{r yearly_trade_summary, echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)


yearly_trade_summary <- df_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^[0-9]{4}$"),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "yearly_value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(partner, year, stk_flow) %>%
  summarise(
    total_yearly_value = sum(yearly_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_transactions = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = stk_flow, 
    values_from = c(total_yearly_value, num_transactions),
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    net_trade_balance = total_yearly_value_EXP - total_yearly_value_IMP,
    total_trade_volume = total_yearly_value_EXP + total_yearly_value_IMP,
    export_import_ratio = total_yearly_value_EXP / total_yearly_value_IMP
  ) %>%
  arrange((partner), (year))

# calculate % change between 2013 and 2024
calculate_pct_change <- function(df, value_column) {
  df %>%
    group_by(partner) %>%
    summarise(
      first_value = first(!!sym(value_column)),
      last_value = last(!!sym(value_column)),
      last_year = last(year),
      pct_change = ((last_value - first_value) / first_value) * 100,
      label = paste0(ifelse(pct_change >= 0, "+", ""), round(pct_change, 1), "%")
    )
}

#Calculate changes for each metrics
pct_change_export <- calculate_pct_change(yearly_trade_summary, "total_yearly_value_EXP")
pct_change_import <- calculate_pct_change(yearly_trade_summary, "total_yearly_value_IMP")
pct_change_ratio <- calculate_pct_change(yearly_trade_summary, "export_import_ratio")

# Joins of the data
export_data <- yearly_trade_summary %>%
  left_join(pct_change_export, by = "partner")

import_data <- yearly_trade_summary %>%
  left_join(pct_change_import, by = "partner")

ratio_data <- yearly_trade_summary %>%
  left_join(pct_change_ratio, by = "partner")

# Trillion format
format_trillion <- function(x) {
  paste0(round(x / 1e6, 1), " T")
}

# Colors palette: BLUE for Export, Green for Import
custom_colors_export <- c(
  "UE2020" = "#1E90FF",           
  "Rest_of_the_World" = "#0047AB"
)

custom_colors_import <- c(
  "UE2020" = "#7FF777",          
  "Rest_of_the_World" = "#2E8B57"
)

# Personalized theme
theme_custom <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
  )

# Tags for Export
pct_change_export_positioned <- pct_change_export %>% 
  left_join(yearly_trade_summary %>% 
              group_by(partner) %>% 
              slice_tail(n = 1) %>% 
              select(partner, year, total_yearly_value_EXP), 
            by = "partner") %>%
  mutate(
    label_y = case_when(
      total_yearly_value_EXP == max(total_yearly_value_EXP) ~ total_yearly_value_EXP * 1.05,
      TRUE ~ total_yearly_value_EXP * 0.95
    )
  )

# Tags for Import
pct_change_import_positioned <- pct_change_import %>% 
  left_join(yearly_trade_summary %>% 
              group_by(partner) %>% 
              slice_tail(n = 1) %>% 
              select(partner, year, total_yearly_value_IMP), 
            by = "partner") %>%
  mutate(
    label_y = case_when(
      total_yearly_value_IMP == max(total_yearly_value_IMP) ~ total_yearly_value_IMP * 1.05,
      TRUE ~ total_yearly_value_IMP * 0.95
    )
  )

# Tags fot the ratio
pct_change_ratio_positioned <- pct_change_ratio %>% 
  left_join(yearly_trade_summary %>% 
              group_by(partner) %>% 
              slice_tail(n = 1) %>% 
              select(partner, year, export_import_ratio), 
            by = "partner") %>%
  mutate(
    label_y = case_when(
      export_import_ratio == max(export_import_ratio) ~ export_import_ratio * 1.05,
      TRUE ~ export_import_ratio * 0.95
    )
  )

# Export plot
ex <- ggplot(export_data, aes(x = year, y = total_yearly_value_EXP, color = partner, group = partner)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    data = pct_change_export_positioned,
    aes(x = year, y = label_y, label = label),
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = format_trillion,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors_export) +
  labs(
    title = "Total Yearly Export Value",
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Export Value (Trillion EUR)",
    color = "Partner"
  ) +
  theme_custom

# Import plot
im <- ggplot(import_data, aes(x = year, y = total_yearly_value_IMP, color = partner, group = partner)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    data = pct_change_import_positioned,
    aes(x = year, y = label_y, label = label),
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = format_trillion,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors_import) +
  labs(
    title = "Total Yearly Import Value",
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Import Value (Trillion EUR)",
    color = "Partner"
  ) +
  theme_custom

# ratio plot
ratio <- ggplot(ratio_data, aes(x = year, y = export_import_ratio, color = partner, group = partner)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    data = pct_change_ratio_positioned,
    aes(x = year, y = label_y, label = label),
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = format_number,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors_export) +
  labs(
    title = "Export/Import Ratio",
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Export/Import Ratio",
    color = "Partner"
  ) +
  theme_custom

# Calcolate correlations
correlation_export_import <- cor(
  yearly_trade_summary$total_yearly_value_EXP, 
  yearly_trade_summary$total_yearly_value_IMP, 
  use = "complete.obs"
)

correlation_ue <- yearly_trade_summary %>%
  filter(partner == "UE2020") %>%
  summarise(
    correlazione_export_import_ue = cor(
      total_yearly_value_EXP, 
      total_yearly_value_IMP, 
      use = "complete.obs"
    )
  )

correlation_extra_ue <- yearly_trade_summary %>%
  filter(partner == "Rest_of_the_World") %>%
  summarise(
    correlazione_export_import_extra_ue = cor(
      total_yearly_value_EXP, 
      total_yearly_value_IMP, 
      use = "complete.obs"
    )
  )

results_correlation <- data.frame(
  Area = c("Export-Import", "Rest of the World", "UE2020"),
  Correlation = c(
    correlation_export_import,
    correlation_extra_ue$correlazione_export_import_extra_ue,
    correlation_ue$correlazione_export_import_ue
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    R_squared = Correlation^2
  )

print(results_correlation)

# Visualizzazione dei grafici
print(im)
print(ex)
print(ratio)


# Salvataggio dei grafici a 200 DPI
ggsave("export_yearly_value.jpg", im, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("import_yearly_value.jpg", ex, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("export_import_ratio.jpg", ratio, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# --- 1. Data preparation ---

yearly_trade_summary <- df_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^[0-9]{4}$"),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "yearly_value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(partner, year, stk_flow) %>%
  summarise(
    total_yearly_value = sum(yearly_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_transactions = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = stk_flow, 
    values_from = c(total_yearly_value, num_transactions),
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    net_trade_balance = total_yearly_value_EXP - total_yearly_value_IMP,
    total_trade_volume = total_yearly_value_EXP + total_yearly_value_IMP,
    export_import_ratio = total_yearly_value_EXP / total_yearly_value_IMP
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) %>%
  arrange(partner, year) %>%
  mutate(partner = factor(partner, levels = c("UE2020", "Rest_of_the_World")))


# --- 2. Barplot function ---

target_years <- c(2013, 2024)
prepare_barplot_data <- function(df, value_col) {
  # 1. % change
  stats <- df %>%
    filter(year %in% target_years) %>%
    group_by(partner) %>%
    arrange(year) %>%
    summarise(
      val_2013 = first(!!sym(value_col)),
      val_2024 = last(!!sym(value_col)),
      max_val = max(!!sym(value_col)),
      pct_change = ((val_2024 - val_2013) / val_2013) * 100,
      label_pct = paste0(ifelse(pct_change >= 0, "+", ""), round(pct_change, 1), "%"),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # 2. filter
  plot_data <- df %>%
    filter(year %in% target_years) %>%
    select(partner, year, all_of(value_col)) %>%
    rename(value = !!sym(value_col)) %>%
    mutate(year = as.factor(year))
  
  list(data = plot_data, stats = stats)
}

# --- 3. preparing the plots ---

data_export <- prepare_barplot_data(yearly_trade_summary, "total_yearly_value_EXP")
data_import <- prepare_barplot_data(yearly_trade_summary, "total_yearly_value_IMP")

# --- 4. Common scale ---
global_max_value <- max(c(data_export$data$value, data_import$data$value), na.rm = TRUE)
common_y_limit <- c(0, global_max_value * 1.25)

# --- 5. Colors & plot formatting ---

format_trillion_short <- function(x) paste0(round(x / 1e6, 2), "T")
format_number_short <- function(x) format(round(x, 2), decimal.mark = ",")

colors_export <- c("UE2020" = "#1E90FF", "Rest_of_the_World" = "#0047AB")
colors_import <- c("UE2020" = "#F7B9F9", "Rest_of_the_World" = "#FA52FF")

theme_custom <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                              size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"), 
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )


# --- 6. create the function plots ---
create_barplot <- function(data_list, title, y_lab, fill_colors, formatter, manual_limits = NULL) {
  
  df_bars <- data_list$data
  df_stats <- data_list$stats
  
  p <- ggplot(df_bars, aes(x = as.factor(year), y = value, fill = partner)) +
    geom_col(
      aes(alpha = as.factor(year)), 
      width = 0.6, 
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.2, 
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ partner, nrow = 1, strip.position = "bottom") +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = formatter(value)),
      vjust = -0.5,
      size = 3.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = df_stats,
      aes(x = 1.5, y = max_val, label = label_pct),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = -2,
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("2013" = 0.6, "2024" = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = y_lab
    ) +
    theme_custom +
    theme(
      strip.placement = "outside",         
      strip.background = element_blank(),  
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "cm")        
    )

  if (!is.null(manual_limits)) {
    p <- p + scale_y_continuous(labels = formatter, limits = manual_limits, expand = expansion(mult = 0))
  } else {
    p <- p + scale_y_continuous(labels = formatter, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2)))
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# --- 7. plot the plots ---
p10 <- create_barplot(
  data_export, 
  title = "Export Value: 2013 vs 2024", 
  y_lab = "Export (Trillion EUR)", 
  fill_colors = colors_export,
  formatter = format_trillion_short,
  manual_limits = common_y_limit
)

p20 <- create_barplot(
  data_import, 
  title = "Import Value: 2013 vs 2024", 
  y_lab = "Import (Trillion EUR)", 
  fill_colors = colors_import,
  formatter = format_trillion_short,
  manual_limits = common_y_limit
)

print(p10)
print(p20)

ggsave("barplot_export_13_24.jpg", p10, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("barplot_import_13_24.jpg", p20, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

# --- 1. Format function ---
format_value_label <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x >= 1e6 ~ paste0(round(x / 1e6, 2), " T"),
    x >= 1e3 ~ paste0(round(x / 1e3, 1), " B"),
    TRUE     ~ paste0(round(x, 0), " M")
  )
}

# --- 2. Colors palette ---
colors_export_sectors_custom <- c(
  "Services" = "#094782",
  "ICT & Financial Services" = "#0b72d7",
  "Transport & Logistics" = "#098bf5",
  "Health, Education & Culture" = "#54b5fb",
  "Construction" = "#71c0a7",
  "Mining & Energy" = "#54AAAA",
  "Agriculture" = "#478AAA",
  "Textile & Footwear" = "#325462",
  "Public Administration" = "#6b91b4"
)

# --- 3. Plot function ---
create_sector_comparison_plot <- function(df, flow_col, flow_name, color_palette) {
  
  df_filtered <- df %>%
    filter(partner == "UE2020", year %in% c(2013, 2024)) %>%
    select(year, general_sector, value = !!sym(flow_col)) 
  
  df_stats <- df_filtered %>%
    arrange(general_sector, year) %>%
    group_by(general_sector) %>%
    summarise(
      val_2013 = first(value),
      val_2024 = last(value),
      pct_change = ((val_2024 - val_2013) / val_2013) * 100,
      label_pct = paste0(ifelse(pct_change >= 0, "+", ""), round(pct_change, 1), "%")
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(desc(pct_change)) 
  ordered_levels <- df_stats$general_sector
  
  plot_data <- df_filtered %>%
    left_join(df_stats, by = "general_sector") %>%
    mutate(
      general_sector = factor(general_sector, levels = ordered_levels),
      year = factor(year, levels = c("2024", "2013")) 
    )

  max_val <- max(plot_data$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  expand_limit <- max_val * 1.45 
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(y = year, x = value, fill = general_sector)) +
    facet_grid(general_sector ~ ., switch = "y", space = "free_y", scales = "free_y") +
    
    geom_col(
      aes(alpha = year), 
      width = 0.8,
      color = NA,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      aes(label = format_value_label(value)),
      hjust = -0.1, 
      size = 3.5,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "gray30"
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      data = plot_data %>% filter(year == "2024"), 
      aes(label = label_pct, x = max_val * 1.3),
      inherit.aes = TRUE,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 4,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("2013" = 0.4, "2024" = 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)), limits = c(0, expand_limit)) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste0("Sector Evolution: ", flow_name),
      subtitle = "Ordered by % Growth (Highest to Lowest) | 2013 (Top) vs 2024 (Bottom)",
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "sans", color = "#222222"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray50", margin = margin(b = 20)),
      strip.placement = "outside",          
      strip.background = element_blank(),   
      strip.text.y.left = element_text(     
        angle = 0,                          
        face = "bold", 
        size = 11, 
        hjust = 1                           
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray40", face = "bold"), 
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),        
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linetype = "dotted"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "lines"),   
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
    )
}

p_sect_exp <- create_sector_comparison_plot(
  sector_trade_summary, 
  "total_yearly_EXP", 
  "Export (UE2020)", 
  colors_export_sectors_custom
)

p_sect_imp <- create_sector_comparison_plot(
  sector_trade_summary, 
  "total_yearly_IMP", 
  "Import (UE2020)", 
  colors_export_sectors_custom
)

print(p_sect_exp)
print(p_sect_imp)

ggsave("ue_sector_export_sorted_growth.jpg", p_sect_exp, width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave("ue_sector_import_sorted_growth.jpg", p_sect_imp, width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales) 
library(ggrepel)

# --- PREPARAZIONE DATI (stesso codice di prima) ---
ue_export_data <- sector_trade_summary %>%
  filter(partner == "UE2020") %>%
  select(year, general_sector, Total = total_yearly_EXP) %>%
  arrange(general_sector, year)

df_with_growth <- ue_export_data %>%
  group_by(general_sector) %>%
  arrange(year) %>% 
  mutate(
    first_value = first(Total),
    last_value = last(Total),
    pct_change = ((last_value - first_value) / first_value) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

label_data <- df_with_growth %>%
  group_by(general_sector) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(ifelse(pct_change >= 0, "+", ""), round(pct_change, 1), "%"),
    label_x = year,
    label_y = Total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- PALETTE COLORI ---
colors_export_sectors_custom <- c(
  "Services" = "#094782",
  "ICT & Financial Services" = "#0b72d7",
  "Transport & Logistics" = "#098bf5",
  "Health, Education & Culture" = "#54b5fb",
  "Construction" = "#71c0a7",
  "Mining & Energy" = "#57b956",
  "Agriculture" = "#478f48",
  "Textile & Footwear" = "#326633",
  "Public Administration" = "#6b91b4"
)

# --- FUNZIONE DI FORMATTAZIONE ---
format_trillion <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x >= 1e12 ~ paste0(round(x/1e12, 1), "W"),
    x >= 1e9 ~ paste0(round(x/1e9, 1), "W"),
    x >= 1e6 ~ paste0(round(x/1e6, 1), "T"),
    x >= 1e3 ~ paste0(round(x/1e3, 1), "B"),
    TRUE ~ as.character(round(x, 0))
  )
}

# ========================================
# PLOT EXPORT - LINEAR
# ========================================
plot_ue_export_linear <- ggplot(df_with_growth, aes(x = year, y = Total, group = general_sector)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, aes(color = general_sector)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7, aes(color = general_sector)) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_data,
    aes(label = label, x = label_x, y = label_y, color = general_sector),
    size = 3.5, 
    fontface = "bold", 
    show.legend = FALSE,
```

```{r MAPPE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(maps)
library(viridis)
library(classInt)

# MAPPING FOR THE MAP PLOT
eu_countries_mapping <- c(
  "Austria" = "Austria",
  "Belgium" = "Belgium",
  "Bulgaria" = "Bulgaria",
  "Croatia" = "Croatia",
  "Cyprus" = "Cyprus",
  "Czech Rep." = "Czech Republic",
  "Denmark" = "Denmark",
  "Estonia" = "Estonia",
  "Finland" = "Finland",
  "France" = "France",
  "Germany" = "Germany",
  "Greece" = "Greece",
  "Hungary" = "Hungary",
  "Ireland" = "Ireland",
  "Italy" = "Italy",
  "Latvia" = "Latvia",
  "Lithuania" = "Lithuania",
  "Luxembourg" = "Luxembourg",
  "Malta" = "Malta",
  "Netherlands" = "Netherlands",
  "Poland" = "Poland",
  "Portugal" = "Portugal",
  "Romania" = "Romania",
  "Slovakia" = "Slovakia",
  "Slovenia" = "Slovenia",
  "Spain" = "Spain",
  "Sweden" = "Sweden"
)

# DATA PREPARATION FUNCTION
prepare_trade_data <- function(df, flow_type) {
  df %>%
    filter(stk_flow == flow_type, partner == "UE2020", State != "EU27_2020") %>%
    group_by(State) %>%
    summarise(
      value_2013 = sum(as.numeric(`2013`), na.rm = TRUE),
      value_2024 = sum(as.numeric(`2024`), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      change = value_2024 - value_2013,
      pct_change = ((value_2024 - value_2013) / value_2013) * 100
    )
}

export_data <- prepare_trade_data(df_wide, "EXP")
import_data <- prepare_trade_data(df_wide, "IMP")
world_map <- map_data("world")
europe_map_full <- world_map %>%
  filter(long >= -14 & long <= 36 & lat >= 36 & lat <= 74)
europe_map_eu <- world_map %>%
  filter(region %in% eu_countries_mapping)

# Natural Breaks (Jenks) fot the best chunks
all_values <- c(export_data$value_2013, export_data$value_2024,
                import_data$value_2013, import_data$value_2024)
all_values_clean <- all_values[all_values > 0 & !is.na(all_values)]
breaks <- classIntervals(all_values_clean, n = 5, style = "jenks")$brks

# FORMAT BREAK
format_break <- function(x) {
  sapply(x, function(val) {
    if (val >= 1e9) {
      paste0(round(val/1e9, 1), "W")
    } else if (val >= 1e6) {
      paste0(round(val/1e6, 0), "T")
    } else if (val >= 1e3) {
      paste0(round(val/1e3, 0), "B")
    } else {
      as.character(round(val, 0))
    }
  })
}

# Categories tags
category_labels <- paste0(
  format_break(breaks[-length(breaks)]), " - ", 
  format_break(breaks[-1])
)

assign_category <- function(value) {
  if (is.na(value) || value == 0) return(NA)
  category <- cut(value, breaks = breaks, labels = category_labels, include.lowest = TRUE)
  return(as.character(category))
}

export_data <- export_data %>%
  mutate(
    cat_2013 = sapply(value_2013, assign_category),
    cat_2024 = sapply(value_2024, assign_category)
  )

import_data <- import_data %>%
  mutate(
    cat_2013 = sapply(value_2013, assign_category),
    cat_2024 = sapply(value_2024, assign_category)
  )

# map function
prepare_map_data <- function(trade_data, cat_col) {
  state_to_region <- data.frame(
    State = names(eu_countries_mapping),
    region = as.character(eu_countries_mapping),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Merge trade data with mapping
  trade_mapped <- trade_data %>%
    left_join(state_to_region, by = "State") %>%
    select(State, region, category = all_of(cat_col))
  
  # Merge with map
  map_data <- europe_map_eu %>%
    left_join(trade_mapped, by = "region")
  
  return(map_data)
}

export_2013_map <- prepare_map_data(export_data, "cat_2013")
export_2024_map <- prepare_map_data(export_data, "cat_2024")
import_2013_map <- prepare_map_data(import_data, "cat_2013")
import_2024_map <- prepare_map_data(import_data, "cat_2024")

# Common theme
map_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18, margin = margin(t = 5, b = 10)),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  )



# Color palette
colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#C3FCFF","#032457"))(length(category_labels))
category_labels_ordered <- category_labels
colors_ordered <- setNames(colors, category_labels_ordered)

# Map 1: Export 2013
p1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = europe_map_full, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "grey95", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_polygon(data = export_2013_map, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = category),
               color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, xlim = c(-12, 32), ylim = c(36, 71)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colors_ordered,
    name = "Trade Value\n(EUR)",
    na.value = "grey95",
    limits = category_labels_ordered,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(title = "EU Exports - 2013") +
  map_theme

# Map 2: Export 2024
p2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = europe_map_full, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "grey95", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_polygon(data = export_2024_map, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = category),
               color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, xlim = c(-12, 32), ylim = c(36, 71)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colors_ordered,
    name = "Trade Value\n(EUR)",
    na.value = "grey95",
    limits = category_labels_ordered,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(title = "EU Exports - 2024") +
  map_theme

# Map 3: Import 2013
p3 <- ggplot() +

               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "grey95", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2) +

# Map 4: Import 2024
p4 <- ggplot() +
```

```{r MAPPA_SFOCATURA}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(maps)
library(viridis)

prepare_trade_data <- function(df, flow_type) {
  df %>%
    filter(stk_flow == flow_type, partner == "UE2020", State != "EU27_2020") %>%
    group_by(State) %>%
    summarise(
      value_2013 = sum(as.numeric(`2013`), na.rm = TRUE),
      value_2024 = sum(as.numeric(`2024`), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      change = value_2024 - value_2013,
      pct_change = ((value_2024 - value_2013) / value_2013) * 100
    )
}

# Prepare the 2 maps
export_pct_map <- prepare_map_data_pct(export_data)
import_pct_map <- prepare_map_data_pct(import_data)

# Find the range
all_pct_values <- c(export_data$pct_change, import_data$pct_change)
all_pct_values_clean <- all_pct_values[!is.na(all_pct_values) & is.finite(all_pct_values)]

min_pct <- min(all_pct_values_clean, na.rm = TRUE)
max_pct <- max(all_pct_values_clean, na.rm = TRUE)
limits_pct <- c(min_pct, max_pct)

cat("Range variazione percentuale:", round(min_pct, 1), "% to", round(max_pct, 1), "%\n")

# Map 1: Export - %
p_export_pct <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = europe_map_full, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "grey95", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_polygon(data = export_pct_map, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = pct_change),
               color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, xlim = c(-12, 32), ylim = c(36, 71)) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#d73027",           # Rosso per valori negativi/bassi
    mid = "#ffffbf",           # Giallo per valori intorno a zero
    high = "#1a9850",          # Verde per valori positivi/alti
    midpoint = 0,              # Centro della scala a 0%
    limits = limits_pct,
    na.value = "grey95",
    name = "% Change\n2013-2024",
    labels = function(x) paste0(ifelse(x >= 0, "+", ""), round(x, 0), "%")
  ) +
  labs(title = "EU Exports - % Change 2013-2024") +
  map_theme

# Map 2: Import - %
p_import_pct <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = europe_map_full, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "grey95", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2) +

  coord_fixed(1.3, xlim = c(-12, 32), ylim = c(36, 71)) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#d73027",
    mid = "#ffffbf",
    high = "#1a9850",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = limits_pct,
    na.value = "grey95",
    name = "% Change\n2013-2024",
    labels = function(x) paste0(ifelse(x >= 0, "+", ""), round(x, 0), "%")
  ) +
  labs(title = "EU Imports - % Change 2013-2024") +
  map_theme


# alternative without <0 values
if (min_pct >= 0) {
  p_export_pct_alt <- ggplot() +
    geom_polygon(data = europe_map_full, 
                 aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
                 fill = "grey95", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_polygon(data = export_pct_map, 
                 aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = pct_change),
                 color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    coord_fixed(1.3, xlim = c(-12, 32), ylim = c(36, 71)) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#C3FCFF",          
      high = "#032457",  
      limits = limits_pct,
      na.value = "grey95",
      name = "% Change\n2013-2024",
      labels = function(x) paste0("+", round(x, 0), "%")
    ) +
    labs(title = "EU Exports - % Change 2013-2024") +

  p_import_pct_alt <- ggplot() +

      labels = function(x) paste0("+", round(x, 0), "%")
    ) +
    labs(title = "EU Imports - % Change 2013-2024") +

}

print(p_export_pct)
```

```{r MAPPA_CLASSI_PERCENTUALI}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(maps)

# Funzione per preparare dati di trade (export o import)
prepare_trade_data <- function(df, flow_type) {
  df %>%
    filter(stk_flow == flow_type, partner == "UE2020", State != "EU27_2020") %>%
    group_by(State) %>%
    summarise(
      value_2013 = sum(as.numeric(`2013`), na.rm = TRUE),
      value_2024 = sum(as.numeric(`2024`), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      change = value_2024 - value_2013,
      pct_change = ((value_2024 - value_2013) / value_2013) * 100
    )
}

# Preparazione dati per Export e Import
export_data <- prepare_trade_data(df_wide, "EXP")
import_data <- prepare_trade_data(df_wide, "IMP")

# Carica mappa mondo completa
world_map <- map_data("world")

# Mappa Europa completa (tutti i paesi)
europe_map_full <- world_map %>%
  filter(long >= -14 & long <= 36 & lat >= 36 & lat <= 74)

# Solo paesi EU per i dati
europe_map_eu <- world_map %>%
  filter(region %in% eu_countries_mapping)


# Verifica il range dei dati
all_pct_values <- c(export_data$pct_change, import_data$pct_change)
all_pct_values_clean <- all_pct_values[!is.na(all_pct_values) & is.finite(all_pct_values)]

min_pct <- min(all_pct_values_clean, na.rm = TRUE)
max_pct <- max(all_pct_values_clean, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Range variazione percentuale:", round(min_pct, 1), "% to", round(max_pct, 1), "%\n")

# Definisci breaks "tondi" basati sul range dei tuoi dati
# Esempio: 0-50, 50-100, 100-150, 150-200, 200-250
# Adatta questi valori in base al tuo range effettivo

# Opzione 1: Se i valori vanno da 0 a ~250%
breaks_pct <- c(0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300)

# Opzione 2: Se hai valori negativi
# breaks_pct <- c(-50, 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250)

# Filtra i breaks per includere solo quelli rilevanti per i tuoi dati
breaks_pct <- breaks_pct[breaks_pct >= floor(min_pct/50)*50 & breaks_pct <= ceiling(max_pct/50)*50]
if (breaks_pct[1] > min_pct) breaks_pct <- c(floor(min_pct/50)*50, breaks_pct)
if (breaks_pct[length(breaks_pct)] < max_pct) breaks_pct <- c(breaks_pct, ceiling(max_pct/50)*50)

# Crea etichette leggibili
category_labels_pct <- paste0(breaks_pct[-length(breaks_pct)], "% - ", breaks_pct[-1], "%")

cat("\nCategorie create:\n")
for(i in 1:length(category_labels_pct)) {
  cat(i, ":", category_labels_pct[i], "\n")
}

# Funzione per assegnare categoria
assign_pct_category <- function(value) {
  if (is.na(value) || !is.finite(value)) return(NA)
  category <- cut(value, breaks = breaks_pct, labels = category_labels_pct, include.lowest = TRUE)
  return(as.character(category))
}

# Aggiungi categorie ai dati
export_data <- export_data %>%
  mutate(pct_cat = sapply(pct_change, assign_pct_category))

import_data <- import_data %>%
  mutate(pct_cat = sapply(pct_change, assign_pct_category))

# ========================================
# PREPARAZIONE DATI MAPPA
# ========================================

prepare_map_data_pct <- function(trade_data) {
  state_to_region <- data.frame(
    State = names(eu_countries_mapping),
    region = as.character(eu_countries_mapping),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  trade_mapped <- trade_data %>%
    left_join(state_to_region, by = "State") %>%
    select(State, region, pct_change, pct_cat)
  
  map_data <- europe_map_eu %>%
    left_join(trade_mapped, by = "region")
  
  return(map_data)
}

export_pct_map <- prepare_map_data_pct(export_data)
import_pct_map <- prepare_map_data_pct(import_data)

# ========================================
# TEMA E PALETTE
# ========================================

map_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 18, 
                              margin = margin(t = 5, b = 5), color = "white"),
    legend.position = "left",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, color = "white"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "white"),
    legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
  )

#PALETTE
colors_pct <- colorRampPalette(c("#C3FCFF", "#4A90E2", "#032457"))(length(category_labels_pct))
colors_pct_ordered <- setNames(colors_pct, category_labels_pct)

# ========================================
# CREATE THE MAP
# ========================================

p_export_pct <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = europe_map_full, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "grey95", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_polygon(data = export_pct_map, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = pct_cat),
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, xlim = c(-12, 32), ylim = c(36, 71)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colors_pct_ordered,
    name = "% Change\n2013-2024",
    na.value = "grey95",
    limits = category_labels_pct,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(title = "EU Exports - % Change 2013-2024") +
  map_theme

p_import_pct <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = europe_map_full, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "grey95", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_polygon(data = import_pct_map, 
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = pct_cat),
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, xlim = c(-12, 32), ylim = c(36, 71)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colors_pct_ordered,
    name = "% Change\n2013-2024",
    na.value = "grey95",
    limits = category_labels_pct,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(title = "EU Imports - % Change 2013-2024") +
  map_theme

print(p_export_pct)
print(p_import_pct)

ggsave("EU_EXP_PctChange_2013_2024.png", p_export_pct, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("EU_IMP_PctChange_2013_2024.png", p_import_pct, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)

# --- 1. DATA PREPARATION ---
bubble_df <- sector_trade_summary %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2013, 2024),
         partner %in% c("UE2020")) %>%
  group_by(general_sector, year) %>%
  summarise(total_EXP = sum(total_yearly_EXP), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = total_EXP) %>%
  mutate(
    GrowthPerc = ((`2024` - `2013`) / `2013`) * 100,
    Value2024 = `2024`,
    Value2024_T = `2024` / 1e6  # Converti in Trilioni
  )

min_growth <- min(bubble_df$GrowthPerc, na.rm = TRUE)
max_growth <- max(bubble_df$GrowthPerc, na.rm = TRUE)

# Stampa statistiche per capire la distribuzione
cat("=== DISTRIBUZIONE VALORI ===\n")
print(bubble_df %>% arrange(desc(Value2024_T)) %>% select(general_sector, Value2024_T, GrowthPerc))
cat("\nMin:", round(min(bubble_df$Value2024_T), 2), "T\n")
cat("Max:", round(max(bubble_df$Value2024_T), 2), "T\n")
cat("Median:", round(median(bubble_df$Value2024_T), 2), "T\n")

# --- 2. BUBBLE PLOT CON SCALA LINEARE OTTIMIZZATA ---
p <- ggplot(bubble_df, aes(x = Value2024_T, y = GrowthPerc, 
                            size = Value2024_T, 
                            fill = GrowthPerc,
                            label = general_sector)) +
  
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, color = "white", stroke = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  # Etichette con dimensione fissa e anti-sovrapposizione
  geom_text_repel(
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black",
    bg.color = "white",
    bg.r = 0.15,
    box.padding = 0.8,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.size = 0.5,
    max.overlaps = 30,
    force = 3,
    force_pull = 0.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # Scala X in Trilioni
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(round(x, 2), "T"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.2))
  ) +
  
  # Scala Y con segno percentuale
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(ifelse(x >= 0, "+", ""), round(x, 1), "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.2))
  ) +
  
  # SCALA LINEARE con range REALMENTE proporzionale
  # Se min = 0.5T e max = 6T, il rapporto è 12:1
  # Quindi se la bolla piccola è 4, la grande deve essere 48
  scale_size_area(
    max_size = 40,  # Massima dimensione della bolla
    labels = function(x) paste0(round(x, 2), "T"),
    name = "Export Value 2024"
  ) +
  
  # Palette blu-azzurro (gradiente basato su crescita)
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#C3FCFF",
    high = "#032457",
    labels = function(x) paste0(ifelse(x >= 0, "+", ""), round(x, 1), "%"),
    name = "Growth %\n2013-2024"
  ) +
  
  # Etichette assi e titolo
  labs(
    title = "Sector Momentum: Growth vs Market Size",
    subtitle = "Export Analysis 2013-2024 intra UE",
    x = "Export Value in 2024 (Trillion EUR)",
    y = "Growth % (2013-2024)"
  ) +
  
  # Tema pulito e professionale
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(15, 20, 15, 15),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

print(p)

# --- 3. SALVATAGGIO ---
ggsave("sector_momentum_bubble_chart.png", p, 
       width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave("sector_momentum_bubble_chart.jpg", p, 
       width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

```
